cases.sentence: ___ остановился на короткое время на политике и на том, как смотрят в высших сферах в Петербурге на последние события.
cases.translation: The conversation paused briefly on politics and on how the highest circles in Petersburg viewed recent events.
cases.explain: Разговор is the subject of остановился (came to a stop), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: ...с которым он не видался со времени своей ___.
cases.translation: ...whom he had not seen since the time of his marriage.
cases.explain: The phrase со времени (since the time of) governs the genitive case, giving женитьбы.

cases.sentence: ...видит зависимость его от ___ и в этой зависимости отыскивает законы развития.
cases.translation: ...sees its dependence on its environment and in that dependence seeks the laws of development.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from/on) governs the genitive case, giving среды.

cases.sentence: ...об естественных условиях рабочего в отношении к ___», — сказал Котовасов.
cases.translation: "...about the natural conditions of the laborer in relation to the land," said Kotovasov.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward/in relation to) governs the dative case, giving земле.

cases.sentence: Потом Котовасов своим громким крикливым голосом прочел свою ___ об ученых трудах юбиляра.
cases.translation: Then Kotovasov, in his loud, shrill voice, read out his note on the scholarly works of the man being honored.
cases.explain: The transitive verb прочел (read) takes a direct object in the accusative case, giving записку.

cases.sentence: Левин... сошелся опять близко с бывшим товарищем по университету ___ Котовасовым.
cases.translation: Levin had again become close with his former university comrade, professor Kotovasov.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case, giving профессором.

cases.sentence: Разговор остановился на короткое время на ___ и на том, как смотрят в высших сферах в Петербурге на последние события.
cases.translation: The conversation paused briefly on politics and on how the highest circles in Petersburg viewed recent events.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governs the prepositional case, giving политике.

cases.sentence: Три старые профессора в ___ не приняли мнение молодых.
cases.translation: Three old professors on the Council did not accept the opinion of the younger ones.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in/on) governs the prepositional case, giving совете.

reading.ru: Левин в этот свой приезд сошелся опять близко с бывшим товарищем по университету профессором Котовасовым, с которым он не видался со времени своей женитьбы.
reading.question: Who did Levin become close with again during this stay in Moscow?
options: His former university comrade, Professor Kotovasov
reading.correct: His former university comrade, Professor Kotovasov
reading.explain: The text says Levin grew close again with his former university comrade, Professor Kotovasov.

reading.ru: Левин думал, что ясность мира созерцания Котовасова вытекала из бедности его натуры.
reading.question: What did Levin privately think was the source of Kotovasov's clarity of worldview?
reading.explain: The text says Levin thought Kotovasov's clarity stemmed from the poverty of his nature.

reading.ru: Левин читал Котовасову некоторые места из своего сочинения, и они понравились ему.
reading.question: How did Kotovasov react when Levin read him passages from his work?
reading.explain: The text says the passages pleased Kotovasov.

reading.ru: Метров будет у него завтра в 11 часов и очень рад познакомиться с ним.
reading.question: When was Metrov expected to meet Levin?
options: At Kotovasov's, at 11 o'clock the next day
At the university the following week
reading.correct: At Kotovasov's, at 11 o'clock the next day
reading.explain: Kotovasov tells Levin that Metrov will be at his place at 11 o'clock and is glad to meet him.

reading.ru: Ну что? Каковы черногорцы?» «По породе воины».
reading.question: What topic did Kotovasov and Levin briefly discuss upon greeting?
options: The Montenegrins, described as warriors by nature
reading.correct: The Montenegrins, described as warriors by nature
reading.explain: The exchange calls the Montenegrins warriors by their very nature.

reading.ru: Котовасов в коротких словах передал ему последнее известие и, войдя в кабинет, познакомил Левина с невысоким, плотным, очень приятной наружности человеком. Это был Метров.
reading.question: How is Metrov first described when Levin meets him?
options: A short, stout man of very pleasant appearance
An elderly man with a long beard
reading.correct: A short, stout man of very pleasant appearance
reading.explain: The text describes Metrov as a short, stout man of very pleasant appearance.

reading.ru: Да вот написал почти книгу об естественных условиях рабочего в отношении к земле», — сказал Котовасов.
reading.question: What had Metrov nearly written a book about, according to Kotovasov?
options: The natural conditions of the laborer in relation to the land
The history of the Russian nobility
reading.correct: The natural conditions of the laborer in relation to the land
reading.explain: Kotovasov says Metrov has almost written a book on the natural conditions of the laborer in relation to the land.

reading.ru: Я, собственно, начал писать сельскохозяйственную книгу, но, невольно занявшись главным орудием сельского хозяйства, рабочим, — сказал Левин краснее, — пришел к результатам совершенно неожиданным
reading.question: What happened when Levin tried to write an agricultural book?
options: He ended up with completely unexpected results after focusing on the laborer
He abandoned it after losing interest
He decided to focus on livestock instead
reading.correct: He ended up with completely unexpected results after focusing on the laborer
reading.explain: Levin says he began writing an agricultural book but, having focused on the laborer, arrived at completely unexpected results.

reading.ru: Но в чем же вы видите особенные свойства русского рабочего?» — сказал Метров.
reading.question: What did Metrov ask Levin about the Russian laborer?
options: What special qualities Levin saw in him
How much he earned per year
reading.correct: What special qualities Levin saw in him
reading.explain: Metrov asks Levin what special properties he sees in the Russian laborer.

reading.ru: этот взгляд русского народа вытекает из сознания им своего призвания заселить огромные незанятые пространства на Востоке
reading.question: According to Levin, where did the Russian people's special view of the land come from?
options: A sense of their calling to settle the vast unoccupied lands of the East
reading.correct: A sense of their calling to settle the vast unoccupied lands of the East
reading.explain: Levin says this view stems from a sense of the calling to settle the vast unoccupied spaces of the East.

reading.ru: Легко быть введено в заблуждение, делая заключение об общем призвании народа», — сказал Метров, перебивая Левина.
reading.question: How did Metrov respond to Levin's theory about the Russian people's calling?
options: He warned it was easy to be led into error making such broad conclusions
He asked Levin to publish it immediately
reading.correct: He warned it was easy to be led into error making such broad conclusions
reading.explain: Metrov interrupts Levin, warning it is easy to be misled drawing conclusions about a people's general calling.

reading.ru: Состояние рабочего всегда будет зависеть от его отношения к земле и капиталу».
reading.question: What did Metrov believe the laborer's condition always depended on?
options: His relation to land and capital
reading.correct: His relation to land and capital
reading.explain: Metrov states the laborer's condition will always depend on his relation to land and capital.

reading.ru: Левин слушал неохотно и сначала возражал.
reading.question: How did Levin initially respond while listening to Metrov's theory?
options: He listened reluctantly and objected at first
He fell asleep during the explanation
He left the room in frustration
reading.correct: He listened reluctantly and objected at first
reading.explain: The text says Levin listened reluctantly and objected at first.

reading.ru: убедившись, что они до такой степени различно смотрят на дело, что никогда не поймут друг друга, он уже и не противоречил, и только слушал
reading.question: Why did Levin eventually stop arguing with Metrov?
options: He realized they saw the matter so differently they would never understand each other
He agreed Metrov was entirely correct
reading.correct: He realized they saw the matter so differently they would never understand each other
reading.explain: The text says he stopped arguing once convinced they saw things too differently ever to understand each other.

reading.ru: Самолюбие его было польщено тем, что такой ученый человек, так охотно, с таким вниманием и доверием к знанию предмета Левином, иногда одним намеком указывая на целую сторону дела, высказывал ему свои мысли.
reading.question: What flattered Levin during the conversation with Metrov?
options: That such a learned man shared his thoughts with attention and trust
That Metrov offered him a job
That Metrov praised his book publicly
That Metrov agreed with all his conclusions
reading.correct: That such a learned man shared his thoughts with attention and trust
reading.explain: The text says Levin's vanity was flattered that such a learned man spoke his thoughts to him with attention and trust.

reading.ru: Однако мы опоздаем», — сказал Котовасов, взглянув на часы, как только Метров кончил свое изложение.
reading.question: What did Kotovasov say once Metrov finished his explanation?
options: That it was time for dinner
That he needed to leave for the elections
reading.explain: Kotovasov says they will be late, glancing at his watch as soon as Metrov finished.

reading.ru: Так как Левин уже все это слышал, он поторопился сказать Метрову, что сожалеет, что не может воспользоваться его приглашением, раскланялся и поехал ко Львову.
reading.question: How did Levin's meeting with Metrov and Kotovasov end?
options: Levin declined Metrov's invitation and went on to Lvov's
Levin agreed to move in with Metrov
Levin and Metrov argued until they parted angrily
Levin stayed the whole evening at Metrov's home
reading.correct: Levin declined Metrov's invitation and went on to Lvov's
reading.explain: The text says Levin declined Metrov's invitation, took his leave, and went on to Lvov's.
